# vendor/shiftpane

Copied from [kwiruu/shiftpane](https://github.com/kwiruu/shiftpane) at `a20960f5cbda099262a2cb3c7715657d127ddb49` by
`pnpm sync:shiftpane`: the widget format (`@shiftpane/widget-sdk`) and the widget renderer
(`@shiftpane/board`, with what it needs), so the gallery draws widgets exactly as the app and the
phone do. Don't edit these files here; change them in the app and copy them again.

Weather and Countdown settings, typography and gradient additions are from ShiftPane bab4eee. Existing contribution-calendar support is preserved from the marketplace main branch.
